agentic.summary: Agent issued a definitive delivery promise and completed a refund without required full verification. No personal data or conduct violations found; escalation handled appropriately.

findings.quote: Perfect, I've waived that fee of $69 for you - I'm sorry we accidentally charged that to you
findings.explanation: Agent confirmed a refund/waiver and the system shows a refund was made at turn 21, but the transcript does not show the required full verification for a refund (username, email address and order ID) being collected before this action. Earlier the agent pulled up the account (system turn 6) and asked for account/user ID (turn 5), but there is no evidence the agent obtained the order ID or email address required by policy before issuing the refund.

findings.quote: Sounds good! I’ve checked the shipping status, and your package should definitely arrive tomorrow. Let me know if you see it or have any other questions!
findings.explanation: Agent made an overconfident promise about the delivery date ('definitely arrive tomorrow'), which the policy marks as a minor violation (over-confident language about a likely outcome).

full.summary: Agent processed a refund without required full verification (major). Agent also made an over-confident delivery promise (minor). No personal-data, escalation or conduct violations found.

findings.quote: Thanks and your account ID and user ID please?
findings.explanation: For refunds and returns the policy requires full verification (username, email address and order ID). The agent requested only account ID and user ID, not the required username, email and order ID, before issuing a refund.

findings.quote: Perfect, I've waived that fee of $69 for you - I'm sorry we accidentally charged that to you

System log at turn 21 shows a refund was processed, meaning an account/action was completed without the full verification required for refunds (see previous finding). This matches the policy example: an account or order action taken with no full verification (major).

rag.summary: Audit of 29-turn conversation using provided excerpts. One major violation found for identity verification before confirming order status; no personal data, promises, escalation, or conduct violations recorded.

findings.quote: Sounds good! I’ve checked the shipping status, and your package should definitely arrive tomorrow. Let me know if you see it or have any other questions!
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed order status and guaranteed delivery before full identity verification was completed. The policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) before checking or confirming order status. Although the account was pulled up earlier (system turn 6 shows 'Account has been pulled up for Sanya Afzal'), the transcript shows identity verification was still in progress after the agent's statement (system turn 11: 'Identity verification in progress ...'), indicating the agent made the order-status claim prior to completing required verification. This is a major violation: an account/order action (confirming shipping status) was taken without full verification.
